Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cur_week_day varchar2(3) ;
 cur_eff_date date ;
 cur_term_date date ;
 rg_count number ;
 cursor c1 is
 select eff_date,
 nvl(term_date,to_date('01012099','MMDDYYYY')) term_date
 from resource_avail_rules
 where resource_code = :control_block.s_resource_code
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and week_day = :resource_avail_rules.week_day
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) < sysdate;
begin
 /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 This trigger checks with the record group for possible overlapping of
 effective date, in case there are two records for the same resource code
 and week day combination. It also updates the record group with the current
 data entered. 
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 rg_count := get_group_row_count('RSRC_RULES') ;
 for i in 1..rg_count loop
 if i != to_number(:system.trigger_record) or
 :in_rg is null then /*-- Donot compare the record with itself --*/
 if get_group_char_cell('RSRC_RULES.WEEK_DAY',i) = :week_day then
 cur_eff_date := get_group_date_cell('RSRC_RULES.EFF_DATE',i) ;
 /*-- Set term date to very high value, if null --*/
 cur_term_date := nvl(get_group_date_cell('RSRC_RULES.TERM_DATE',i),to_date('01012099','MMDDYYYY')) ;

 /*if cur_term_date is null then
 show_error('11155') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif*/

 if :eff_date >= cur_eff_date and
 :eff_date < cur_term_date then
 show_error('11156') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif :term_date is not null and
 :term_date > cur_eff_date and
 :term_date <= cur_term_date then
 show_error('11157') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;

 /* check records not retreived into form */
 for cur in c1 loop 
 if :eff_date >= cur.eff_date and
 :eff_date < cur.term_date then
 IF :TERM != 'TERM' and :CHK_TERM != 'T' THEN 
 show_error('11156') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 END IF;
 elsif :term_date is not null and
 :term_date > cur.eff_date and
 :term_date <= cur.term_date then
 IF :TERM != 'TERM' and :CHK_TERM != 'T' THEN 
 show_error('11157') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 END IF;
 end if ;
 end loop;
 if :system.record_status != 'NEW' then
 rg_count := to_number(:system.trigger_record); 
 if :in_rg is null then
 :in_rg := 'Y';
 Add_Group_Row( 'RSRC_RULES', rg_count );
 end if ;
 Set_Group_Char_Cell('RSRC_RULES.WEEK_DAY' ,rg_count, :week_day); 
 Set_Group_Date_Cell('RSRC_RULES.EFF_DATE' ,rg_count, :eff_date); 
 Set_Group_Date_Cell('RSRC_RULES.TERM_DATE',rg_count, :term_date); 
 end if;
end ;

Block.QueryDataSourceName:
select sort_seq, res_code, chap,sum(mon) mon, sum(tue) tue, sum(wed) wed, sum(thu) thu, sum(fri) fri, sum(sat) sat, sum(sun) sun
from
( select resource_code res_code,chapter_id chap,
 max_available mon, 0 tue, 0 wed, 0 thu, 0 fri, 0 sat, 0 sun
 from resource_avail_rules
 where week_day = 'MON'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time (chapter_id,sysdate) between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chapter_id,sysdate)+10)
 union
 select resource_code res_code,chapter_id chap,
 0 mon, max_available tue, 0 wed, 0 thu, 0 fri, 0 sat, 0 sun
 from resource_avail_rules
 where week_day = 'TUE'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time (chapter_id,sysdate) between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chapter_id,sysdate)+10)
 union
 select resource_code res_code,chapter_id chap,
 0 mon, 0 tue, max_available wed, 0 thu, 0 fri, 0 sat, 0 sun
 from resource_avail_rules
 where week_day = 'WED'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time (chapter_id,sysdate) between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chapter_id,sysdate)+10)
 union
 select resource_code res_code,chapter_id chap,
 0 mon, 0 tue, 0 wed, max_available thu, 0 fri, 0 sat, 0 sun
 from resource_avail_rules
 where week_day = 'THU'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time (chapter_id,sysdate) between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chapter_id,sysdate)+10)
 union
 select resource_code res_code,chapter_id chap,
 0 mon, 0 tue, 0 wed, 0 thu, max_available fri, 0 sat, 0 sun
 from resource_avail_rules
 where week_day = 'FRI'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time (chapter_id,sysdate) between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chapter_id,sysdate)+10)
 union
 select resource_code res_code,chapter_id chap,
 0 mon, 0 tue, 0 wed, 0 thu, 0 fri, max_available sat, 0 sun
 from resource_avail_rules
 where week_day = 'SAT'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time (chapter_id,sysdate) between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chapter_id,sysdate)+10)
 union
 select resource_code res_code,chapter_id chap,
 0 mon, 0 tue, 0 wed, 0 thu, 0 fri, 0 sat, max_available sun
 from resource_avail_rules
 where week_day = 'SUN'
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time (chapter_id,sysdate) between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(chapter_id,sysdate)+10)
), valid_resources
where res_code = resource_code
group by sort_seq, res_code,chap

PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
BEGIN
 /*-- Force validation --*/
 :control_block.s_resource_code := :control_block.s_resource_code;
 IF nvl(:control_block.term,'XXXX') = 'TERM' 
 or :control_block.chk_term = 'T'
 THEN
 set_block_property('resource_avail_rules',INSERT_ALLOWED, property_false);
 set_item_property('resource_avail_rules.max_available',updateable, property_false);
 IF :control_block.chk_term = 'T' THEN
 set_item_property('resource_avail_rules.term_date',updateable, property_false);
 END IF; 
 ELSE
 set_block_property('resource_avail_rules',INSERT_ALLOWED, property_true);
 set_item_property('resource_avail_rules.max_available',updateable, property_true);
 set_item_property('resource_avail_rules.term_date',updateable, property_true);
 END IF;

 Delete_group_row('RSRC_RULES',ALL_ROWS);
 go_block('resource_avail_rules') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 execute_query ;
 item_change('CHK_TERM','D') ;
 item_change('S_RESOURCE_CODE','D') ;
 set_item_property('RESRC_LOV_BUTTON',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('RETRIEVE_BUTTON',enabled,property_false);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: NAVIGATE_AROUND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE navigate_around(p_what in varchar2) IS
 -- Value for p_what 'IN' - 'OUT'
 rg_id recordgroup;
 cl_id1 groupcolumn;
 cl_id2 groupcolumn;
 item_name varchar2(100);
 ctr number(3) := 1;
BEGIN
 IF upper(p_what) = 'IN' THEN
 :global.cursor_item := :system.cursor_item;
 rg_id := find_group('BLK_DET');
 IF not ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 delete_group(rg_id);
 END IF; 
 rg_id := create_group('BLK_DET');
 cl_id1 := add_group_column(rg_id,'ITEM_NAME',CHAR_COLUMN,60);
 cl_id2 := add_group_column(rg_id,'ITEM_STATUS',CHAR_COLUMN,10);
 item_name := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_block,FIRST_ITEM);
 LOOP
 IF item_name IS NULL THEN
 exit;
 END IF; 
 IF get_item_property(:system.cursor_block || '.'|| item_name, item_type) = 'TEXT ITEM'
 and get_item_property(:system.cursor_block || '.'|| item_name, enabled) = 'TRUE'
 THEN
-- message(:system.cursor_block || '.' || item_name);
-- message(get_item_property(:system.cursor_block || '.'|| item_name, item_is_valid)); 
 add_group_row(rg_id, ctr);
 set_group_char_cell(cl_id1,ctr,:system.cursor_block || '.' || item_name);
 set_group_char_cell(cl_id2,ctr,
 get_item_property(:system.cursor_block || '.'|| item_name, item_is_valid));
 ctr := ctr + 1; 
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_block || '.'|| item_name, item_is_valid, property_true); 
 END IF;
 item_name := get_item_property(:system.cursor_block|| '.' ||item_name, NEXTITEM);
 END LOOP;
 ELSIF upper(p_what) = 'OUT' THEN
 rg_id := FIND_GROUP('BLK_DET');
 IF ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 return;
 END IF;
 cl_id1 := FIND_COLUMN('BLK_DET.ITEM_NAME');
 cl_id2 := FIND_COLUMN('BLK_DET.ITEM_STATUS');
 ctr := get_group_row_count(rg_id);

 FOR i in 1 .. ctr
 LOOP
 IF get_group_char_cell(cl_id1,i) = :GLOBAL.cursor_item THEN
 set_item_property
 (get_group_char_cell(cl_id1,i),ITEM_IS_VALID,property_false);
 ELSIF (get_group_char_cell(cl_id2,i)) = 'TRUE' THEN
 set_item_property
 (get_group_char_cell(cl_id1,i),ITEM_IS_VALID,property_true);
 ELSIF (get_group_char_cell(cl_id2,i)) = 'FALSE' THEN
 set_item_property
 (get_group_char_cell(cl_id1,i),ITEM_IS_VALID,property_false);
 END IF; 
 END LOOP;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.cursor_item);
 erase('GLOBAL.cursor_item'); 
 END IF; 
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 ret_val varchar2(1) ;
begin
 check_password(:banner.prog_name,ret_val) ;
 if ret_val = 'Y' then
 /*-- DO NOT REMOVE this VALIDATE_FORM. This fires all the validations in the form
 and stops processing if any failure occurs. Problem that I found with COMMIT_FORM is that 
 although it validates the whole form, it did not stop processing when any failure 
 occurred in the WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD trigger of RESOURCE_AVAIL_RULES block. ---*/

 validate(form_scope);
 check_package_failure;

 commit_form ; 
 if form_success then
 show_error('9163') ;
 else
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
end ;
